title: Campaigns rain down, sign-ups flow
description: daily ad spend (from top, $K) vs sign-ups (flow, hundreds) · 30 days

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered daily observations: day, spendK in thousands of dollars, and signUps as a count. Null or invalid measures remain unavailable without removing their day; zero is measured. The spend scale starts at $0–18K and expands for larger values; the sign-up scale starts at zero and adapts to the data.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot aspect ratio.

props.name: width
props.description: Fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills the containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures; each plot identifies its measure.
